t: This is Ashmole Primary School in Lambeth. It was designed by Edward Robert Robson, an English architect famous for the progressive spirit of his London state-funded school buildings of the 1870s and early 1880s. Robson worked in the years when public schooling was being built up across the capital, and his schools were known for their forward-looking approach. So as you look at the school, you're looking at the work of someone who helped shape what a London board school could be.
